title: Oversummoned, Overpowered, and Over It!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Inori Takafuji, a lazy young man, is summoned to another world to defeat a villain, then summoned again and again to new worlds, gaining a new power each time. The manga adapts a light novel; database tags describe him as an increasingly ruthless, nonhuman (vampire) anti-hero in darker storylines than the comic blurb suggests.
life_message: Unclear from sources; the protagonist mainly wants to be left alone and uses overwhelming power on his own terms.
